basic_info.description: Delightful and sun filled three bedroom two bath home with a detached vacant 2 bedroom apartment located in the highly desirable Bernal Heights neighborhood of SF! The main house features a spacious floor plan with gorgeous floors throughout the home that are flooded with natural light, a large gourmet eat-in-kitchen, formal living room and dining room, three bedrooms on one level and two tastefully remodeled bathrooms. The lower level offers a big garage with workspace and plenty of room to park at least 3 cars. The back part of the property has a private, vacant two bedroom apartment that has been recently remodeled & is above its own garage. Don't miss this wonderful home with additional income potential in a truly special neighborhood!
